name: Fool's Paradise
author: Dave Purdum
description: A top-down shooter: fly your ship over the land, blast the enemy craft and survive from one day to the next, with hearts for health.

descriptions.en: A top-down shooter: fly your ship over the land, blast the enemy craft and survive from one day to the next, with hearts for health.
descriptions.it: Uno sparatutto visto dall'alto: pilota la tua nave sul territorio, abbatti i velivoli nemici e sopravvivi un giorno dopo l'altro, con i cuori come salute.
